description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Language, which manages localization and message handling for the HTML Purifier library, including loading language-specific messages, formatting messages, and retrieving error names.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Language
classes.description: Represents a language, managing localizable messages, error names, and related functions for the HTML Purifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the language object with configuration and context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language data from the factory cache if not already loaded.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a localized message by key.

methods.name: getErrorName
methods.description: Retrieves a localized error name based on error number.

methods.name: listify
methods.description: Converts an array list into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a message string with substitution parameters.
